About Us
A singular focus
Our goal is to be the preferred service provider to North America's process industries for performing the critical maintenance and upgrading work required to their facilities.
Our Focus
JVIC is a leading provider of turnaround and specialty services to North America's process industries.
Our operating model is designed to deliver on each of the critical components for a successful turnaround – deep technical expertise; the ability to respond to unexpected challenges; highly efficient processes; delivery of the highest quality outcomes; and specialist safety protocols.
Our History
JVIC's founders began their careers as craftsmen, working as a welder and a boilermaker. They established JVIC in 1998 as a specialist welding firm based on the insight that the intense nature of turnaround work requires an unusual emphasis on both the technical and the craft components of performance.
JVIC continues to emphasize the team and personal dimensions of our business and to foster the collaborative, performance-oriented culture that is committed to the highest levels of quality and safety.
JVIC has been a Zachry Group Company since 2012.
